title: Tech Note: Build a Multi-View Planner with SVG
author: Herve LE MARCHAND, 4D Developer
featured_technology: 4D SVG Component (SVG_SET_ID, SVG SET/GET ATTRIBUTE, SVG_SET_VISIBILITY)
Collision/covering management algorithms for schedule items

historical_commentary.text: Building an interactive Gantt-style multi-view planner by directly manipulating a 3000-line SVG document via the 4D SVG Component was an impressively deep, CRUD-like (create/retrieve/update/delete) technique for its era, and the underlying SVG Component and its commands still exist in 4D today. That said, developers building rich scheduling/planning UIs now more commonly reach for a Web Area hosting a modern JavaScript scheduling/charting library (or increasingly, Qodly Studio's web/mobile component model), which offers far richer interactivity and easier styling than hand-rolled SVG attribute manipulation. The MVC architectural discipline the note applies to 4D forms and methods remains sound generic advice regardless of the specific rendering technology chosen.
related_updates: Web Area-hosted JavaScript charting/scheduling libraries are now the more common approach for rich interactive planners in 4D applications
Qodly Studio (4D's low-code web/mobile builder) offers a more modern, component-based alternative for building this kind of interactive UI
